name: CustomEcom Admin Dashboard
summary: Open-source ecommerce admin dashboard template built with Next.js, shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS.
description: An ecommerce admin panel with pages for products (list, create, details), orders, customers and settings. All UI and client-side logic — no backend — so it can be wired to any API or database; forms use React Hook Form and Zod.
contains: pages: products list/create/details, orders, customers, settings
no backend — UI and client-side logic only
modular sidebar, header and table layouts
stack: Next.js App Router, shadcn/ui, Tailwind, React Hook Form, Zod, Lucide
